en-UK.name: Web Browse
en-UK.description: Lets AI characters open a web page and read its content.
en-UK.description_markdown:
The **Web Browse** plugin gives AI characters a `<web-browse>` tool that fetches a URL, cleans the page and converts it to Markdown for the model to read.

Some code is derived from [GentianAphrodite](https://github.com/steve02081504/GentianAphrodite).
en-UK.author: steve02081504

zh-CN.name: 网页浏览
zh-CN.description: 让 AI 角色打开网页并阅读其内容
zh-CN.description_markdown:
**网页浏览**插件为 AI 角色提供 `<web-browse>` 工具：抓取指定网址、清理页面并转换为 Markdown 供模型阅读。

部分代码来自[龙胆](https://github.com/steve02081504/GentianAphrodite)。
zh-CN.author: steve02081504
